translations.literal: Reviewer of Works in the Ministry Chen Jing presented: "Jing formerly as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices on the fourth day of the ninth month of the second year of Jianzhong already presented a memorial on the placement of the Offering and Majestic ancestors at he feasting and asked that the hundred officials broadly gather doubts.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewer of Works Chen Jing submitted: "Jing formerly as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices on the fourth day of the ninth month of the second year of Jianzhong already memorialized on the placement of the Offering and Majestic ancestors at he feasting and asked that the hundred officials broadly gather doubts.

sentences.zh: 其時禮儀使顏真卿因是上狀，與京議異，京議未行。

translations.literal: At that time Ritual Commissioner Yan Zhenqing therefore presented a memorial differing from Jing's; Jing's proposal was not enacted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ritual Commissioner Yan Zhenqing therefore submitted a memorial differing from Jing's; Jing's proposal was not enacted.

sentences.zh: 伏見去年十一月二十八日詔下太常卿裴鬱所奏，大抵與京議相會。

translations.literal: We observe the edict of the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month of last year ordering what Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Pei Yu submitted, broadly agreeing with Jing's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: We see the edict of the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month of last year ordering what Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Pei Yu submitted, broadly agreeing with Jing's proposal.

sentences.zh: 伏以興聖皇帝，同獻祖之曾祖，懿祖之高祖。

translations.literal: We respectfully submit that Emperor Xingsheng was great-great-grandfather to the Offering Ancestor and great-great-great-grandfather to the Majestic Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: We submit that Emperor Xingsheng was great-great-grandfather to the Offering Ancestor and great-great-great-grandfather to the Majestic Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 夫以曾孫祔列于曾、高之廟，豈禮之不可哉？

translations.literal: That a great-great-grandson to be enshrined in the temples of great-great and great-great-great grandfathers—is ritual impossible?
translations.idiomatic: For a great-great-grandson to be enshrined in the temples of great-great and great-great-great grandfathers—is ritual impossible?

translations.idiomatic: Assistant Metropolitan Governor Wei Wu submitted: "Generally he is every three years, di every five years.

translations.idiomatic: He means all temples gather in great union; di means each orders its distant temples.

translations.literal: When tablets move ever farther and distant-temple chambers are complete, in the he year the Offering Ancestor should sit east-facing and the Majestic Ancestor ordered in zhao and mu to exhaust nearest kin.

sentences.zh: 是則于太祖不為降屈，于獻祖無所厭卑。

translations.idiomatic: Then toward the Grand Ancestor there is no lowering; toward the Offering Ancestor there is no disdain of baseness.

translations.idiomatic: Assistant Magistrate of Tongguan Zhong Ziling submitted: "Now Confucians cite the words 'though the son is equal in sageliness, he does not precede the father in eating,' wishing to have the already distant Offering Ancestor temporarily sit east-facing, matching Heaven with the Grand Ancestor while the Grand Ancestor humbly takes zhao-mu—this is extremely unprincipled.

translations.idiomatic: From Wei and Jin onward the Grand Ancestor was always near; above the Grand Ancestor there were always removed tablets.

translations.idiomatic: Only Eastern Jin's Cai Mo relied on the Zuo Commentary's 'not preceding in eating' as doctrine, wishing to have the Western Expedition face east.

translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Cai Mo's proposal was not what Jin enacted.

translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Xingsheng to the Offering Ancestor is great-great-grandfather; zhao-mu are ordered and offerings are timely.

translations.literal: Still, every five days the chamber doors are to be opened for sprinkling and sweeping."
translations.idiomatic: Still, every five days open the chamber doors for sprinkling and sweeping."

sentences.zh: 」其後又有玄宗子靜德太子廟，肅宗子恭懿太子廟。

translations.literal: Afterward there there were also temples for Emperor Xuanzong's son the Jingde Crown Prince and Emperor Suzong's son the Gongyi Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward there were also temples for Emperor Xuanzong's son the Jingde Crown Prince and Emperor Suzong's son the Gongyi Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 孝敬廟在東京太廟院內，貞順皇后、讓皇帝廟在京中。

translations.literal: The Xiaojing Temple was within the Eastern Capital the Grand Temple compound; the temples of Empress Zhenshun and the Yielding Emperor were in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiaojing Temple was within the Eastern Capital Grand Temple compound; the temples of Empress Zhenshun and the Yielding Emperor were in the capital.

sentences.zh: 餘皆四時致祭。

translations.literal: The remainder all had offerings at the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The rest all received seasonal offerings at the four seasons.
